characters.name: Vexwing
characters.description: Segmented bone-veined neon moth with iridescent wing armor and luminous skeletal chest.

characters.name: Gillrot
characters.description: Gillrot · radioactive punk axolotl: six feathery gills, toxic mohawk, glowing exposed rib cage, ragged hoodie, split-color eyes and sly serrated grin
characters.personality: Chaotic, curious, toxic-puddle scavenger. Mischief: winks and bubbles radioactive slime.

characters.name: Hexgourd
characters.description: Engraved pumpkin gremlin with vine grooves, glowing grimace and a haunted stem.

characters.name: Nocturnib
characters.description: Nocturnib · gothic punk vampire bat: scalloped bone-ribbed wings, pierced ears, swept fringe, fangs and studded jacket
characters.personality: Nocturnal, smug, dramatic little menace. Mischief: winks and sparks a pink star.

characters.name: Cryptglow
characters.description: Cryptglow · mischievous ectoplasm ghost: spectral torn tails, exposed glowing rib cage, mint-green energy, broken chains, dark punk fringe, mismatched eyes and tiny fangs
characters.personality: A curious, sardonic poltergeist who collects lost secrets and haunts broken arcade machines. Mischief: winks while the ectoplasm flashes.

characters.name: Sludgebyte
characters.description: Toxic mutant slime with acid bubbles, exposed glowing ribs and dripping neon sludge.

characters.name: Riotpaws
characters.description: Undead alley cat with torn ears, bone collar, luminous whiskers and fierce cheek markings.

characters.name: Cinderfang
characters.description: Scorched undead rabbit with glowing stitches, tattered ears and ember dust.

characters.name: Gravebyte
characters.description: Gravebyte · cyber skeleton DJ: chrome jaw, oversized headphones, digital equalizer eyes, glowing robot ribs, pink circuitry and miniature vinyl turntable badge
characters.personality: Cold-sounding but secretly loyal. Talks in glitchy DJ jokes, loves bass drops and rewiring haunted machines. Mischief: LED wink and sparks.

characters.name: Statichex
characters.description: Statichex · cyberpunk alien troublemaker with charged antennae, neon visor eyes, acid highlights and cheek circuitry.
characters.personality: A fast-talking radio pirate obsessed with signal interference, arcade music and noisy machinery.

characters.name: Rattlepop
characters.description: Rattlepop · lacquered candy-coffin ghoul with dripping neon paint, glowing rivets, engraved coffin armor and a serrated skeletal grin.
characters.personality: Overdramatic and sweetly sinister. Keeps snacks in his coffin and treats every jump scare like a birthday surprise.

characters.name: Thornriot
characters.description: Thornriot · botanical cyclops demon with thorn crown, neon-pink armor, luminous layered iris, jagged scarred spikes and fang grin.
characters.personality: A stubborn garden of chaos, defensive but fiercely protective of smaller creatures.

characters.name: Volt Imp
characters.description: An electric gremlin with jagged lightning horns, neon dragon wings, split-color eyes and an electrified forked tail.
characters.personality: Hyperactive and impatient. A walking short circuit who loves to race the lightning.

characters.name: Crypt Koi
characters.description: An aquatic spirit fish with transparent fins, exposed luminous fish-bones, neon scales and floating bubbles.
characters.personality: Dreamy, elusive and happiest haunting submerged arcades.

characters.name: Casket Pup
characters.description: A skeletal coffin hound with floppy spectral ears, glowing ribs, hooked ghost tail and fanged grin.
characters.personality: A mischievous little graveyard watchdog who follows friendly ghosts home.

characters.name: Void Sprout
characters.description: A spiked arcane bloom with a single luminous cosmic eye, radiant violet petals and creeping roots.
characters.personality: Quietly curious; grows stronger wherever the light fails.

characters.name: Minion Mouse
characters.description: Minion Mouse · scrappy gadget-hoarding mouse gremlin with enormous patchwork ears, scavenged goggles, battery backpack, spring-loaded tail and stitched boots.
characters.personality: Quick-witted, shamelessly curious, fiercely loyal to the crew. Steals broken tech and turns it into improbable inventions. Mischief: goggles wink as sparks fly.
characters.tagline: If it beeps, I can steal it.

characters.name: Mini Villain
characters.description: Mini Villain · theatrical tiny gothic tyrant in an enormous tattered magenta cape, towering asymmetric horns, high-collar armor and glowing acid-green scepter.
characters.personality: Magnificent in their own mind, hilariously overconfident and secretly protective of the smaller misfits. Mishap expert with a flair for dramatic entrances. Mischief: smug wink with crackling arcane sparks.

characters.name: The Eddie
characters.description: The Eddie · undead punk tough-guy with a towering neon-green mohawk, stitched face, mismatched eyes, ripped leather jacket, exposed ribs, heavy boots and serrated grin.
characters.personality: Defiant, chaotic and protective. The first into the pit and last to abandon a friend. Mischief: flashes his fanged grin and headbangs hard enough to shake the screen.

characters.name: Gutterkit
characters.description: Scrappy undead alley kitten with stitched fur, curled rat tail and luminous collar.

characters.name: Chunky Monkey
characters.description: Big-hearted, banana-obsessed chaos gremlin with a leather vest and a tail full of trouble.

characters.name: Boo Thang
characters.description: Flirty, mischievous neon ghost with a bright bow, fangs, and a knack for playful hauntings.

artDirection: Original cute-horror metalhead creatures, skeletal cutaways, neon slime, alien punk and sci-fi graveyard energy.
